module on_comb (

    output wire [31:0] t27_y

    assign t27_y = on_comb(x);

    // fn on_comb (line 10)
    function [31:0] on_comb;
        input [31:0] x;
        reg t27_done;
        begin
            t27_done = 1'b0;
            if ((x == 32'd0)) begin
                on_comb = 32'd0;
                t27_done = 1'b1;
            end
            if (1'b1 && !t27_done) begin
                if (({x >> 32'd16} == 32'd1)) begin
                    on_comb = 32'd0;
                    t27_done = 1'b1;
                end
                if (1'b1 && !t27_done) begin
                    on_comb = x;
                    t27_done = 1'b1;
                end
            end
        end
    endfunction
endmodule
